<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/aivision/jobs/{job_id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetch the status and results of an asynchronous AI vision job.
Returns detailed information about the job including all associated tasks, their statuses, results, and processing times.

This endpoint is used to check the status of jobs created by asynchronous operations such as:
- `/mcr/templateVariation` - MCR template variation jobs
- `/aivision/adRefinement` - Ad refinement jobs

The response includes:
- Job-level information (job_id, status, job_type, batch_size)
- Task-level information (task_id, index, status, result URL or JSON string, processingTime, error_msg)
- Progress tracking (total_tasks, completed_tasks, failed_tasks)

Note: For `TEMPLATE_VARIATION` jobs, the `result` field in the tasks array contains a stringified JSON of the optimized template instead of a URL.
